name: Riddle
overview: The Bible presents riddles as a means to test wisdom and understanding, exemplified by Samson's challenge at his feast where he posed a riddle to his guests as a test of their wit. Additionally, the book of Proverbs records riddling expressions from Agur, who reflects on the inscrutable nature of certain realities, listing things that are never satisfied and others that are beyond his comprehension. These passages reveal that riddles in Scripture serve both as intellectual challenges and as poetic reflections on the mysteries of God's creation.
